_comment: The Baking Trip as our first client (2026-11-15: Junyu, prepare everything as if they said yes). Only public business information here: the repo is public. Fill the studio SSM / bank lines after the SSM registration and the business account. Produce the PDFs: python3 scripts/local/client-docs.py clients/c001-the-baking-trip/client.json

client.name: The Baking Trip
client.address: A6, Jalan Rukun 7, Taman Gembira (Happy Garden), 58200 Kuala Lumpur

highlights: Your menu online in the design you have seen: breads, bagels, buns, cakes and coffee, with photos, prices and “sold out”
Customers pre-order for pick-up: they choose the day and the time (Monday and Tuesday closed), with a limit per time slot so you never take more than you can bake

Order at the table: a QR code on each table; customers order on their phone (choices and notes), the kitchen sees the table number and the order on a tablet with a sound, and the counter sees what each table owes and marks it paid
Payment by DuitNow QR with receipt upload from day one; online payment (FPX, cards, e-wallets) once your payment gateway is approved; or “send the order on WhatsApp”
Christmas pre-orders (babka and whole cakes) with a cut-off date and how many are left; whole-cake requests come to your email and WhatsApp
Promo codes, order emails, “track my order”, collection and refund policy, privacy notice and terms (drafts for your lawyer)
Your own shop dashboard on your phone: new orders, “payment received”, “ready”, what to bake tomorrow, prices and sold-out in one tap

feature_edits.Table bookings or festive pre-orders wit: Festive pre-orders with cut-off dates (Christmas, Chinese New Year)

quote.starter_note: up to 20 items; pick-up orders with day and time, DuitNow / online payment; without per-slot limits, the Christmas pre-order page and promo codes
quote.not_included: photography, a new logo, paid ads; the domain name (a .com.my is about RM60–80 a year, paid to the registrar in your name); payment gateway fees (paid to the gateway; DuitNow QR straight to your bank has no gateway fee)
